mode: Light (with Dark Mode Hook for contrast)

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto h-full min-h-screen relative overflow-hidden

surface_styles.cards: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

motion.transitions: framer-motion for step progression (slide left/right to feel like a native mobile app swipe)
motion.micro_interactions: scale-95 on button tap, glowing borders on active selections

image_urls.description: Latino construction worker giving a thumbs up. Use as a background image with a deep blue-900 overlay (bg-blue-900/80) on the Lead Capture hook screen to build trust and relatability.
Abstract emerald/teal tech background. Use during the 'AI is generating' loading screens to convey technological power and magic.
Phone displaying social media. Use in the MARKETING branch when demonstrating the AI Social Studio generating an Instagram Reel.

components.name: BranchingSelector
components.description: A customized radio-group style selector using Framer Motion. Large tap targets with Lucide icons (Star for Presencia, FileText for Negocio, Smartphone for Marketing). Active state gets a 2px emerald border and a subtle emerald glow drop-shadow.

components.name: MagicLoadingState
components.description: Full-screen or card-level loader showing 'La IA está trabajando...' with an animated emerald gradient tracing border (Aceternity style).

components.name: InteractiveMockup
components.description: A CSS-only mobile phone mockup that scales down to fit inside the real mobile screen, used to display the 'NFC Card' or 'Generated Reel'.

instructions_to_main_agent.architecture_decision: Implement a 'Unified Demo with Branching' (Option 2). The user flow: (1) Lead Capture -> (2) 'What is your biggest need?' (Branch Selection) -> (3) Short 3-step targeted magic moment -> (4) Unified Upsell cross-selling all 3 modules.
instructions_to_main_agent.presencia_flow: Step 1: Show an NFC card animation tapping a phone. Step 2: Simulate 5-star Google Reviews pouring in and the WhatsApp booking assistant. Step 3: End with CTA.
instructions_to_main_agent.negocio_flow: Step 1: Input text in Spanish (or use 1-click examples). Step 2: AI Loading Screen. Step 3: Generate English Quote/Invoice UI. Step 4: End with CTA.
instructions_to_main_agent.marketing_flow: Step 1: Input simple Spanish text 'Terminé este techo'. Step 2: AI Loading. Step 3: Show a mockup playing an AI-generated reel/post with their brand colors. Step 4: End with CTA.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, branching cards) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., 'submit-lead-form', 'select-presencia-branch').
instructions_to_main_agent.brand_adherence: Strictly use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Satoshi for body text. Enforce the Emerald and Blue-900 color scheme. Do not introduce purple, teal, or other colors. Follow mobile-first generous padding (p-6/p-8) and ensure contrast ratios are accessible.
